title: Accessible Auto-Focus Directive with afterNextRender
whatThisCodeCovers: Creates an accessible auto-focus attribute directive that focuses target input elements safely on the browser after DOM rendering, avoiding SSR crashes.
breakdown: afterNextRender executes only in the browser context, preventing 'document is not defined' errors during SSR.
ElementRef injects the host DOM element reference with strict type constraints.
Synchronizes element focus after the browser layout and paint phase has completed.
Eliminates boilerplate ngAfterViewInit lifecycle checks and setTimeout workarounds.
expectedOutput: Host input automatically receives focus immediately upon component mount without SSR errors.

title: Click-Outside Directive for Flyouts & Dropdowns
whatThisCodeCovers: Detects user clicks outside a specified container element using ElementRef.contains and dispatches an output event to dismiss dropdowns or modals.
breakdown: @HostListener('document:click') registers a global click listener on the browser document.
this.el.nativeElement.contains(target) verifies whether the clicked DOM node resides within the host element.
output<MouseEvent>() replaces legacy @Output() EventEmitter with Angular 17+ functional output syntax.
Emits an event only when click originated outside the component boundary, perfect for closing flyouts.
expectedOutput: Dropdown menu closes cleanly when user clicks anywhere else on the document.

title: Host Directives Composition API with Input/Output Aliasing
whatThisCodeCovers: Composes multiple reusable behaviors (Tooltip, ClickOutside) onto a component using hostDirectives, aliasing inputs and outputs without template clutter.
breakdown: hostDirectives attaches behavior directives directly to the host component element at compile time.
Avoids deep class inheritance hierarchies by favoring clean functional composition.
The inputs array exposes and renames directive inputs on the host component's public API.
Consumers interact with a single unified component tag while behaviors remain strictly modular.
expectedOutput: FancyButton incorporates highlight and ripple directives seamlessly with exposed inputs.

title: Dynamic Component Portal via ViewContainerRef
whatThisCodeCovers: Dynamically instantiates standalone components into an arbitrary container using ViewContainerRef.createComponent, passing inputs via setInput and subscribing to outputs.
breakdown: outlet().createComponent(AlertBannerComponent) instantiates the standalone component directly into the DOM.
compRef.setInput('message', value) binds properties reactively without manual change detection triggering.
Maintains array of ComponentRef instances to manage lifecycle and clean up on parent destruction.
this.outlet().clear() cleanly destroys all dynamically attached embedded views.
expectedOutput: Clicking spawn inserts a new AlertBannerComponent into the DOM; clear removes all instances.

title: Multi-Slot Content Projection Card with Fallback Content
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements an enterprise card component with multi-slot content projection using CSS selectors and Angular 18 default fallback content.
breakdown: ng-content with select="[card-header]" matches elements decorated with the card-header attribute.
Angular 18 allows nesting default fallback elements directly inside <ng-content>...</ng-content>.
The unselected <ng-content /> acts as the primary catch-all slot for component body content.
Zero JavaScript overhead: slots are resolved purely during compile time by the Ivy template engine.
expectedOutput: Card renders header, body, and footer into designated slots with automatic fallback if header omitted.

title: Custom Debounced Input Directive with RxJS Subject
whatThisCodeCovers: Debounces input keystrokes at the directive level, emitting a clean throttled output event to prevent spamming search endpoints.
breakdown: Subject<string> captures raw browser input events dispatched by the host input element.
debounceTime waits for a pause in typing before emitting the latest value.
distinctUntilChanged prevents emitting identical consecutive values.
takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef) ensures the subscription is cleaned up when input unmounts.
expectedOutput: Typing triggers search callback only after user pauses for specified millisecond window.

title: One-Click Copy-to-Clipboard Directive with Visual Feedback
whatThisCodeCovers: Copies specified text strings to the system clipboard using navigator.clipboard, toggling a temporary 'copied' CSS class on the host element.
breakdown: navigator.clipboard.writeText copies the text string asynchronously to the system clipboard.
Renderer2 safely mutates DOM element class lists in an SSR-compatible way.
input.required ensures compile-time errors if textToCopy is omitted.
Automatically removes visual feedback class after 1.5 seconds.
expectedOutput: Clicking copies target text to clipboard and flashes 'copy-success' class on button.

title: Dynamic Tooltip Directive with CDK Overlay & ConnectedPosition
whatThisCodeCovers: Displays a floating tooltip positioned relative to the target element using Angular CDK Overlay, handling mouseenter and mouseleave triggers.
breakdown: CDK Overlay creates a floating DOM container outside parent clipping layers.
FlexibleConnectedPositionStrategy pins the tooltip above the host element with automatic boundary checking.
ComponentPortal mounts TooltipBoxComponent dynamically inside the overlay pane.
Properly disposes of the overlay in mouseleave and ngOnDestroy to prevent memory leaks.
expectedOutput: Hovering over element displays floating tooltip centered above target element.

title: Infinite Scroll Trigger Directive with IntersectionObserver
whatThisCodeCovers: Emits a scrollEnd event when a sentinel element enters the viewport using IntersectionObserver, triggering pagination for infinite feeds.
breakdown: Uses browser native IntersectionObserver rather than high-frequency window scroll event listeners.
afterNextRender ensures the observer attaches only in browser environments.
threshold: 0.1 fires when the sentinel element is 10% visible in the viewport.
Disconnects observer in ngOnDestroy to prevent memory leaks when navigating away.
expectedOutput: Scrolling to the bottom of the page fires scrolled event, triggering next page fetch.

title: HTML5 Drag-and-Drop File Upload Directive
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements a drag-and-drop file dropzone directive, intercepting dragover and drop events, extracting files, and toggling visual drag states.
breakdown: e.preventDefault() on dragover is mandatory to permit drop events in HTML5.
@HostBinding('class.drag-over') dynamically toggles styling when files hover over target.
Converts FileList into standard JavaScript Array for type-safe processing.
Emits an array of File objects to the parent component.
expectedOutput: Dropping files on host element highlights container and emits selected File array.

title: Signal-Based View Queries with viewChild and viewChildren
whatThisCodeCovers: Leverages modern Angular 17.1+ signal-based viewChild and viewChildren queries to access DOM elements and child components with automatic reactivity.
breakdown: viewChild.required returns a Signal<ElementRef<T>> guaranteed to exist after view initialization.
viewChildren returns a Signal<readonly ElementRef<T>[]> that updates automatically when list changes.
Queries work natively with effect(), eliminating boilerplate ngAfterViewInit subscriptions.
Reading the signal (mainInput().nativeElement) provides instantaneous type-safe DOM access.
expectedOutput: DOM elements accessed cleanly via reactive signals with zero legacy decorator boilerplate.

title: Typeahead Autocomplete Search with switchMap & Cancellation
whatThisCodeCovers: Constructs an enterprise search typeahead input with debouncing, duplicate suppression, and switchMap race-condition cancellation.
breakdown: debounceTime(300) waits 300ms after user stops typing before making network requests.
filter(term => term.length >= 2) ignores single characters to avoid firing heavy queries.
switchMap cancels prior in-flight HTTP calls if the user enters a new keystroke, preventing race conditions.
toSignal converts the RxJS stream into a Signal, rendering cleanly in template without async pipe.
expectedOutput: Smooth search autocomplete that cancels outdated network requests on fast keystrokes.

title: Resilient Polling Stream with timer, exhaustMap & Auto-Teardown
whatThisCodeCovers: Executes periodic background polling for status updates using timer and exhaustMap, avoiding overlapping concurrent requests and cleaning up via takeUntilDestroyed.
breakdown: timer(0, 5000) generates an emission immediately and every 5 seconds thereafter.
exhaustMap drops subsequent timer ticks if the previous HTTP response has not yet completed (slow networks).
takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef) automatically tears down the polling loop when navigating away.
Updates Signals synchronously, ensuring OnPush change detection flags views cleanly.
expectedOutput: Polls server status every 5s without stacking duplicate requests on slow connections.

title: Resilient HTTP Retry with Exponential Backoff & Jitter
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements an exponential backoff retry mechanism with randomized jitter to handle transient network and 503 service unavailable failures gracefully.
breakdown: Uses RxJS 7+ retry({ count, delay: (err, count) => Observable }) signature.
Checks error status code to avoid futile retries on 401 Unauthorized or 404 Not Found.
Exponential backoff scales delay geometrically (1s, 2s, 4s, etc.).
Randomized jitter prevents thousands of clients from hammering a recovering server simultaneously.
expectedOutput: Retries failed requests with increasing intervals and jitter before finally throwing error.

title: Real-Time WebSocket Subject with Auto-Reconnect & Heartbeat
whatThisCodeCovers: Wraps browser WebSocket into an RxJS webSocket subject, handling automatic reconnection on disconnect, ping/pong heartbeats, and message multiplexing.
breakdown: webSocket from rxjs/webSocket provides bidirectional message streaming.
openObserver and closeObserver track socket connection state lifecycle.
retry({ delay: () => timer(3000) }) automatically re-establishes socket connection after dropped network.
shareReplay({ refCount: true }) multiplexes single socket among multiple component subscribers.
expectedOutput: Robust WebSocket stream that automatically re-establishes connection on disconnection.

title: Concurrent Multi-Resource Loader with forkJoin & Loading States
whatThisCodeCovers: Fetches user profile, permissions, and system preferences concurrently using forkJoin, mapping into a unified state model with error protection.
breakdown: forkJoin executes all 3 HTTP requests concurrently in parallel.
Emits only when ALL requests have successfully completed.
Each individual call has localized catchError to prevent a single failure from aborting the entire page.
toSignal delivers synchronous data object to the @if control flow block.
expectedOutput: Dashboard data loaded in parallel with fallback defaults for failing auxiliary endpoints.

title: Sequential Order Processing Queue with concatMap
whatThisCodeCovers: Guarantees strict sequential order of asynchronous tasks using concatMap, processing order submissions one after another without overlap.
breakdown: concatMap enforces strict First-In-First-Out (FIFO) sequential processing.
If user clicks both buttons rapidly, Order 2 waits until Order 1 completes.
Prevents concurrent stock allocation races on transactional backend endpoints.
takeUntilDestroyed cleans up the queue processor on component unmount.
expectedOutput: Orders execute one at a time sequentially regardless of how fast user triggers them.

title: High-Frequency Window Event Throttling with throttleTime
whatThisCodeCovers: Throttles high-frequency window resize and scroll events to 60 FPS using throttleTime and asyncScheduler, updating coordinates smoothly.
breakdown: fromEvent(window, 'scroll') creates an observable stream of scroll events.
runOutsideAngular isolates high-frequency events from Zone.js change detection checks.
throttleTime(16, asyncScheduler, { leading: true, trailing: true }) locks updates to 60 FPS.
trailing: true guarantees the final resting scroll position is always captured.
expectedOutput: Smooth 60 FPS scroll tracking with zero CPU lag or frame dropping.

title: Reactive In-Memory HTTP Cache with shareReplay
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements an in-memory cached data service using shareReplay with bufferSize: 1 and refCount: true, deduplicating HTTP calls across components.
breakdown: shareReplay multicasts the single HTTP response to all current and future subscribers.
bufferSize: 1 replays the latest cached emission immediately upon new subscription.
refCount: true clears the cache if all subscribing components unmount (prevents stale leaks).
invalidateCache allows manual cache invalidation upon mutation operations.
expectedOutput: Multiple components calling getConfig() share 1 single HTTP request.

title: Type-Safe Cross-Component Event Bus with RxJS Subject
whatThisCodeCovers: Builds a decoupled, type-safe global event bus using RxJS Subject and discriminated union types for communication across disparate modules.
breakdown: Subject<AppEvent> acts as the central broadcast pipe.
TypeScript discriminated unions ensure payload types match the event type string.
Custom TypeScript type guard (e is Extract<...>) guarantees type-safe payload extraction.
Provides decoupled pub-sub messaging without direct component-to-component references.
expectedOutput: Type-safe event publishing and subscribing across independent Angular components.

title: Smooth Animated Number Counter using animationFrames & scan
whatThisCodeCovers: Animates an integer counter smoothly from 0 to target value using animationFrames, lerp interpolation, and scan.
breakdown: animationFrames() provides smooth 60/120 FPS timestamp emissions synced with browser paint.
Calculates eased interpolation using cubic ease-out mathematical formula.
takeWhile(val => val < target, true) terminates the stream when target value is reached.
endWith ensures the final displayed value is precisely the specified target number.
expectedOutput: Counter animates smoothly from 0 to 1000 using native browser refresh rate.

title: Multi-Tab Synchronization via BroadcastChannel & RxJS
whatThisCodeCovers: Synchronizes user authentication and cart state across multiple browser tabs using BroadcastChannel wrapped in an RxJS Subject.
breakdown: BroadcastChannel API enables zero-server inter-tab browser communication.
Emits events onto an internal RxJS Subject for clean component/service consumption.
Logging out in one tab immediately forces logouts across all open tabs in same origin.
Gracefully handles environments where BroadcastChannel is unavailable.
expectedOutput: Actions in one browser tab (like logging out) instantly sync across all open tabs.

title: Reactive Shopping Cart State with signal, update & computed
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements a complete reactive shopping cart using signal, computed derived metrics (subtotal, VAT, shipping), and immutable update methods.
breakdown: items writable signal holds the immutable collection of cart items.
computed signals (subtotal, tax, grandTotal) calculate automatically with push-pull glitch-free guarantees.
this.items.update() derives next state from previous state cleanly.
Zero manual subscriptions; components reading grandTotal() update fine-grained on mutation.
expectedOutput: Shopping cart updates items, counts, tax, and free shipping thresholds reactively.

title: Form Synchronization with linkedSignal (Angular 19)
whatThisCodeCovers: Uses Angular 19 linkedSignal to create writable local component state that resets automatically whenever an upstream input signal changes.
breakdown: linkedSignal solves the classic problem where local editable state must track upstream inputs.
Whenever the serverAddress input changes, editableStreet automatically recalculates and resets.
The user can edit the field locally via .set() without mutating the upstream input.
Eliminates complex ngOnChanges lifecycle hooks and manual effect() synchronization.
expectedOutput: Local input changes allow editing, but switching user profiles resets field to new default.

title: Two-Way Model Binding with model() & model.required()
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements two-way banana-in-a-box [()] component binding using Angular 17.2+ model() signals, replacing legacy @Input() and @Output() EventEmitter pairs.
breakdown: model.required<number>() defines a writable signal that acts as an input and an output.
Angular automatically generates the corresponding countChange output event under the hood.
Calling this.count.update() pushes changes to the parent without manual EventEmitter.emit() calls.
Parent binds via [(count)]="parentQuantity", achieving seamless two-way signal synchronization.
expectedOutput: Clicking +/- updates stepper and synchronizes parentQuantity value instantaneously.

title: Full CRUD Entity Store using NgRx SignalStore withEntities
whatThisCodeCovers: Constructs a production-grade entity management store using @ngrx/signals and withEntities, supporting normalized CRUD operations and computed selectors.
breakdown: withEntities<Customer>() normalizes state into ids array and entityMap dictionary.
Exposes out-of-the-box computed signals: entities(), entityMap(), ids().
patchState with addEntity/updateEntity guarantees immutable O(1) dictionary updates.
Zero boilerplate compared to classic NgRx actions, reducers, and selectors.
expectedOutput: Normalized customer state managed with clean methods and automatic entity signals.

title: Persistent LocalStorage Signal Wrapper
whatThisCodeCovers: Creates a custom signal utility that persists state to browser localStorage and updates automatically via effect().
breakdown: Initializes signal with stored localStorage data if available, falling back to default.

SSR safe: guards window.localStorage checks before attempting browser storage access.
Returns standard WritableSignal<T> supporting .set() and .update() methods.
expectedOutput: Signal mutations persist to browser localStorage across page reloads automatically.

whatThisCodeCovers: Demonstrates safe nested object and array updates on Angular Signals without mutating existing memory references.

Arrays are updated immutably using array spread ([...arr, item]) or .map() / .filter().
Guarantees that OnPush change detection and computed signals detect the mutation.
Prevents subtle bugs where shared references are unexpectedly mutated.

title: Undo/Redo State History Stack with Signals
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements an undo/redo state management stack using signals and computed flags (canUndo, canRedo) for rich interactive canvas or text editors.
breakdown: Maintains past, present, and future signal stacks.
canUndo and canRedo computed signals bind directly to button [disabled] attributes.
Pushing a new state wipes out future redo history as expected in standard editors.
Undo moves present to future and pops past to present seamlessly.
expectedOutput: History stack supports undo and redo transitions with reactive UI button disabling.

title: Multi-Criteria Filtering & Sorting Matrix with computed
whatThisCodeCovers: Filters and sorts large collections across multiple criteria (search query, category, price range, sort direction) using a single memoized computed signal.
breakdown: filteredProducts tracks search, selectedCategory, and sortBy dependencies automatically.
Recalculates ONLY when one of the tracked signals changes value.
Returns a new filtered array ready for @for loop rendering with track p.id.
Eliminates duplicate imperative filter methods and out-of-sync UI state.
expectedOutput: Products table filters and sorts reactively with optimal caching.

title: Asynchronous Data Loading with rxResource (Angular 19)
whatThisCodeCovers: Loads async HTTP data into reactive signals using Angular 19 rxResource, managing loading, value, and error states automatically.
breakdown: rxResource automatically re-fetches whenever request signals (this.userId) change.
Exposes out-of-the-box signals: .value(), .isLoading(), .error(), and .status().
Eliminates manual switchMap, loading booleans, and error-handling boilerplate.
Integrates natively with built-in control flow (@if).
expectedOutput: Changing userId re-fetches user, displaying loading spinner and rendering result.

title: Dynamic Theme Switcher with Signal-Driven CSS Variables
whatThisCodeCovers: Toggles application theme between dark and light modes, applying CSS variables to document.documentElement using an Angular effect.

title: Functional Auth Guard with Return URL Redirection
whatThisCodeCovers: Guards protected routes using CanActivateFn, atomically redirecting unauthenticated users to /login and preserving returnUrl query parameter.

state.url contains the full path the user was attempting to visit.
Returning router.createUrlTree cancels the pending navigation and triggers redirect in one turn.

title: Unsaved Changes Guard with CanDeactivateFn & Modal Confirmation
whatThisCodeCovers: Warns users when navigating away from dirty forms using CanDeactivateFn and an asynchronous confirmation dialog.

whatThisCodeCovers: Routes users to completely different components for the exact same URL path based on feature flags using CanMatchFn.

Prevents downloading the v2 chunk for users who are not in the beta test group.

Combines fast initial application loads with instant subsequent page transitions.

breakdown: Typed FormArray manages dynamic list of FormGroup<LineItemForm> entries.

valueChanges stream observes all line item updates and recalculates total.

title: Custom Star Rating Widget implementing ControlValueAccessor
whatThisCodeCovers: Builds a production-ready 5-star rating form widget implementing ControlValueAccessor, integrating with standard reactive forms and validation.

whatThisCodeCovers: Implements an AsyncValidatorFn that checks username availability via HTTP, debouncing requests and returning error objects.

expectedOutput: Input checks availability 400ms after user pauses; flags error if name is taken.

Recalculates automatically whenever either password or confirmPassword changes.
Displays error cleanly in template when parent form exhibits passwordMismatch error.

whatThisCodeCovers: Watches reactive form value changes, debounces modifications by 1 second, and saves draft state automatically with visual saving indicators.

saveStatus signal renders saving confirmation feedback cleanly to user.

title: Tag / Chip Input Component with Custom CVA & Keyboard Navigation
whatThisCodeCovers: Creates an interactive tag/chip input widget implementing ControlValueAccessor with Enter key insertion and Backspace tag deletion.

Enter key listener adds new unique tag and clears input field.
Backspace on empty input deletes the most recently added tag.
Notifies parent form via this.onChange(this.chips) with immutable array reference.
expectedOutput: Tag input widget creates and deletes tags via keyboard and binds with formControl.

title: HTTP Bearer Token Interceptor with 401 Refresh Mutex
whatThisCodeCovers: Intercepts HTTP requests, clones them with Bearer Authorization tokens, and handles 401 Unauthorized errors with a synchronized refresh mutex.
breakdown: Clones outgoing requests to inject the Authorization Bearer header safely.
Catches 401 Unauthorized responses to initiate silent background token refresh.
Uses isRefreshing flag and BehaviorSubject to queue concurrent failing requests.
Retries all queued requests with the newly minted access token once refresh finishes.
expectedOutput: Expired token caught; requests paused while single refresh executes, then seamlessly retried.

title: Global HTTP Error Notification Interceptor
whatThisCodeCovers: Intercepts all outgoing HTTP failures globally, displaying toast alerts for 500, 403, and network errors while preserving original error streams.
breakdown: Catches unhandled HTTP failures centrally across the entire application.
status === 0 identifies client offline or CORS blockage conditions.
Formats friendly user messages rather than exposing raw server stack traces.
Re-throws the error via throwError(() => error) to preserve caller error pipelines.
expectedOutput: Server errors trigger user-friendly toast alerts automatically without component-level try-catch.

title: Non-Destructive SSR Hydration with Event Replay Configuration
whatThisCodeCovers: Configures Angular 18+ non-destructive client hydration with event replay and HTTP transfer cache options in app.config.ts.

title: Platform-Safe Storage Service Guarding Window & LocalStorage
whatThisCodeCovers: Encapsulates localStorage into an injectable service that safely detects browser vs server environments using PLATFORM_ID and isPlatformBrowser.

Wraps browser calls in try-catch to handle Safari Private Browsing quota restrictions.

whatThisCodeCovers: Renders a 100,000 item transaction feed at 60 FPS using ScrollingModule and cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport with fixed itemSize.

whatThisCodeCovers: Spawns a dedicated Web Worker to process heavy calculations off the main UI thread, preserving responsive 60 FPS animation.

expectedOutput: 100-million iteration loop calculates in background without dropping browser UI frames.

title: Pure Memoized Currency & Date Formatting Pipe
whatThisCodeCovers: Creates an enterprise pure memoized pipe that formats numbers into localized currency strings, executing only when input parameters change.
breakdown: pure: true guarantees that Angular skips executing transform() if inputs have not changed.

Handles null, undefined, and NaN inputs gracefully without crashing template rendering.
Zero bundle bloat: lightweight standalone utility pipe.
